dossier.bear_case: It is a single stock outside the plan, share count is up 5% in a year, and a director sold under a 10b5-1 plan last month. One launch scrub resets the story.
dossier.thesis: ACME grew revenue 24% a year for three years and turned an operating profit in 2025. The launch backlog is two years deep.
dossier.what_would_change:
Two clean launches in a row.
Share count stops growing.
The plan makes room for a satellite sleeve.
